stories.headline: Carly Rae Jepsen: Day and Night Album Review - Pitchfork
stories.summary: Read Marissa Lorusso’s review of the album.
stories.why: Carly Rae Jepsen's artistic evolution matters because she's moved from pop bubblegum novelty to a critically respected songwriter, signaling that female pop artists can demand serious credibility on their own terms.

stories.headline: ‘Big Brother’ Season 28, Week 10 Results: Double Eviction Night Reveals Final 5 - Deadline
stories.summary: Julie Chen Moonves returned to host another live eviction of Big Brother, with two houseguests evicted.
stories.why: Big Brother's endgame represents the last bastion of appointment TV for younger men—it's live, unscripted drama that requires real investment and community discussion in an era of algorithmic content.

stories.headline: ‘Resident Evil’ Racing Toward Healthy Box Office Haul for Zach Cregger’s Reboot - hollywoodreporter.com
stories.summary: Austin Abrams stars in Sony's latest feature adaptation of the video game franchise, with the new movie becoming the first in the series to impress critics.
stories.why: A Resident Evil reboot actually working with critics signals that video game adaptations are finally cracking the code, validating the medium's storytelling potential after decades of failures.

stories.headline: 'Stuart Fails To Save The Universe' Wanted Green Lantern, Settled For Flash - Deadline
stories.summary: The creators of 'Stuart Fails To Save The Universe' really did want the Green Lantern to be at the center of the show's DC comic crossover.
stories.why: This DC crossover controversy highlights how fan culture now dictates major studio decisions—when creators publicly admit they compromised creative vision for IP access, it exposes the creative death of franchise filmmaking.

stories.headline: Zara Larsson lashes White House for using her song in deportation video - BBC
stories.summary: The White House removed Larsson's Midnight Sun from one of its reels after the artist called the clip "dehumanising".
stories.why: Zara Larsson forcing the White House to remove her song over its use in a deportation video demonstrates artists now have real leverage to distance themselves from state messaging, a shift in celebrity political agency.

stories.headline: Juilliard Apologizes to Julia Stiles Over Dancing With the Stars Shade—With Gift That’s Truly on Point - E! News
stories.summary: Julia Stiles and Dancing With the Stars partner Ezra Sosa received a special delivery from The Juilliard School, where her Save the Last Dance movie character auditioned to attend.
stories.why: Julia Stiles winning Juilliard's public forgiveness for doing Dancing with the Stars signals a cultural reset where prestige institutions are finally accepting that popular entertainment and artistic credibility aren't mutually exclusive.

stories.headline: Guitar Center Addresses 'Not Legitimate' Entries Submitted in Ed Sheeran Tour Opener Contest - Rolling Stone
stories.summary: Guitar Center has been caught in the growing controversy surrounding Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour following his pro-Palestine comments.
stories.why: Guitar Center's Ed Sheeran contest scandal exposes how political statements now have real economic consequences in entertainment—boycotts from Macklemore's removal actually move needle for major brands, not just Twitter discourse.

stories.headline: Miley Cyrus reveals her final conversation with godmother Dolly Parton - USA Today
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus shared what her last conversation with Dolly Parton was while explaining what made the "Jolene" singer so special.
stories.why: Miley reflecting on her final Dolly conversation matters because it acknowledges the generational mentorship between female artists is ending, marking a genuine cultural transition moment from one era to the next.
